question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, qty as line_qty, amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) as line_seq,
           SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY id) as cum_qty_needed
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
product_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.location_id, i.product_id, i.purchase_id, i.qty as inv_qty,
           p.purchased, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased ASC, i.qty ASC) as inv_rank,
           SUM(i.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased ASC, i.qty ASC) as cum_inv_qty
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE i.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM orderlines WHERE order_id = 423)
      AND l.warehouse = 1
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.*,
        COALESCE(LAG(pi.cum_inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY pi.product_id ORDER BY pi.inv_rank), 0) as prev_cum_inv_qty
    FROM product_inventory pi
),
allocations AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.product_id,
        ol.line_seq,
        ol.cum_qty_needed,
        with_prev.location_id,
        with_prev.aisle,
        with_prev.position,
        with_prev.inv_rank,
        with_prev.inv_qty,
        with_prev.cum_inv_qty,
        with_prev.prev_cum_inv_qty,
        CASE 
            WHEN with_prev.prev_cum_inv_qty IS NULL 
            THEN LEAST(ol.cum_qty_needed, with_prev.inv_qty)
            WHEN with_prev.cum_inv_qty > with_prev.prev_cum_inv_qty 
                 AND with_prev.prev_cum_inv_qty < ol.cum_qty_needed
            THEN LEAST(ol.cum_qty_needed - with_prev.prev_cum_inv_qty, with_prev.inv_qty)
            ELSE 0
        END as alloc_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN with_prev ON ol.product_id = with_prev.product_id
    WHERE with_prev.inv_rank <= 100
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, alloc_qty as qty
FROM allocations
WHERE alloc_qty > 0
ORDER BY product_id, inv_rank
